items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Oh, we played together a long time.

ctx.x: Tillman, call him Hunter, we can call him Hunter, his name is Alan Gorda. Mm-hmm. Willie Newton, Joe Mudhouse, Old Man Nighy, well Tillman's brother, he started playing, but he didn't last long, he didn't stay too long. That was the band that was the first band we started up.
And Tillman was playing clarinet then? Correct. And you were playing drums? I was playing drums. Where did Willie Newton play? The bass of all of them. Well, who is Liberty Newton?
